thoughts.sr: Podatke sa parkinga primio sam pre 7 min i oni sadrže 648 vrednosti, ali ne navode vreme merenja, pa ne mogu da utvrdim gradsku hronologiju promene prikaza VMA sa 557 na 122. Sensor.Community sam takođe primio pre 7 min, ali istovremeni prijem ne potvrđuje da su merenja vršena istovremeno. [F11][F12][F10]
thoughts.en: The parking feed was received 7 min ago and carries 648 values, but it gives no measurement time, so the VMA display’s move from 557 to 122 has no established city chronology [F11] [F12]. Sensor.Community was also received 7 min ago, yet coincident reception does not establish contemporaneous sensing [F10].
questions: What measurement time, if any, accompanies the Parking Servis values?
questions_sr: Koje vreme merenja, ako ga uopšte ima, prati vrednosti sa Parking Servis?
